name: retro-digital-ephemera

motion.headline: word
rules: Background alternates between warm cream deckle cardstock (#F4EFE6) with pulp specks and deep matte carbon void (#0C0C0C) for CRT/hardware beats.
Headlines snap syllable-by-syllable or word-by-word with 1-bit coarse dithered/bitmap edges and a blinking typewriter underscore cursor (_).
Physical hardware items (Olivetti Lettera 22, Nokia 3310, Olivetti CRT monitor, Garakei phones, iPhone 4) act as focal storytelling portals with interactive screens.
Stepped stop-motion cadence on 2s (15fps) or 3s (10fps) with snappy mechanical spring settling.
Match-cuts across eras (mechanical round typewriter keys transitioning into modern terminal keyboard; 1881 print emoticons dissolving into 1982 CRT terminal smilies).
avoid: smooth anti-aliased vector gradients on typography
borderless floating digital UI screenshots without hardware shells
